نتواقف (form VI)
# نَتَوَاقَفُ (natawāqafu) /na.ta.waː.qa.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَوَاقَفَ (tawāqafa)
# نَتَوَاقَفَ (natawāqafa) /na.ta.waː.qa.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَوَاقَفَ (tawāqafa)
# نَتَوَاقَفْ (natawāqaf) /na.ta.waː.qaf/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَوَاقَفَ (tawāqafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
